# Zinereo Pharma brings fertility innovation to the Functional Foods for Wellness Summit 2026 in Bangkok

Zinereo Pharma participated last February in the Functional Foods for Wellness Summit 2026, a leading international event that brings together global experts to explore the future of health, wellness, and scientific innovation. Over two days, the summit highlighted the growing role of the microbiome, while addressing key trends such as prevention and emerging health technologies as drivers of the medicine of the future.

In this context, Ana Nunes, Business Unit Director Microbiome & Probiotics at Zinereo Pharma, participated as a speaker with the presentation “From Microbiota to Fertility: Clinical Trials Exploring FertiBiome’s Efficacy.” During her talk, she presented the clinical development of Fertibiome, our innovative microbiome-based solution designed to support fertility in both women and men, backed by clinical evidence.

Zinereo Pharma’s participation in this international forum reinforces its positioning as a leader in microbiome innovation and its commitment to science as a key driver in advancing reproductive health.
